name: om_apply_health_score
title: Apply MetaFlow Health Score
description: Write a 0-100 health score and per-dimension breakdown back to an OpenMetadata entity as a native custom property (`metaflow_health_score` on the entity's `extension` block). Idempotently registers the custom property on the entity type the first time it's used. Visible in the OpenMetadata UI under the table's Custom Properties panel.
author: metaflow

entity_fqn.description: Fully qualified name of the OpenMetadata entity (e.g. `service.database.schema.table`).

registered.description: True if the custom property was created on this call (first-time use).

implementation.notes: Reference implementation lives in `metaflow/backend/app/core/governance.py` (`write_health_score`). Bridge wraps the FastAPI endpoint; OM uses an `auth` token from `AI_SDK_TOKEN`.

contribution.submission: OpenMetadata Hackathon 2026 — Pick #2: Multi-MCP Agent Orchestrator
contribution.rationale: OM 1.12 ships custom properties but no canonical way for an autonomous agent to write a normalized score back to an entity. This tool defines that contract: a single `metaflow_health_score` extension key, idempotent type registration, and a JSON-PATCH writeback so the score is visible in OM's native UI alongside the entity's other metadata.
